fusions.name: Eightfold Salvo
fusions.desc: Looses 8 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 35% chance of [Poisoned] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A thrown sting that deals 8 damage, up to 1.6 times its damage at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep Reserves
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds. While it lasts, an escort fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
